Two different formats

People usually start looking for an alternative to chat roulette when they get tired of the endless “next”: random people, dark screens, unpleasant surprises. A webcam site like Stripchat is often cited as such a replacement. You just have to remember that these sites are designed differently, and the matter is not limited to the logo.

Chat Roulette connects you via video with a stranger. Both have their cameras on, the conversation is equal, and it’s impossible to guess who will appear in the next second. The webcam site works as a catalog of live broadcasts conducted by adult models. You choose the broadcast yourself, watch it and write in the chat, and you don’t need your own camera for this.

Comparison by points

OptionWebcam siteChat roulette
Who do you seeThe model you choseA random person
Do you need your cameraNo, only optionalAs a rule, yes
Do they see youNo, just your nickname in the chatYes, your face and environment
Age of participantsOnly 18+, models are verifiedDepends on the site and moderation
Communication formatShow and chat with a modelOne-on-one conversation as equals
CostViewing is free, paid tips and private showsUsually free, there are paid filters
Adult contentSpecialized platform 18+Usually prohibited by the rules

The viewer does not need a camera

Former roulette users most often note one thing: no one can see you on the webcam site. No need to adjust the light, tidy up the room, or think that someone will take a screenshot of your face. You can even watch public broadcasts without registration.

Besides, it’s simply more convenient. You don’t need a headset, you don’t need to allow your browser access to your camera and microphone, and you don’t have to worry about your family hearing your conversation. Open the page on your phone or laptop and read the chat like you would a feed from your favorite blog.

Many cam platforms have a cam-to-cam mode in a private show if you want the model to see you. It is turned on only by your decision, it is not required to log in.

Safety and predictability

In roulette, no one promises who will be on the other side of the screen. There can be rudeness, there can be unpleasant content, and on a poorly moderated site you can even end up with a minor. Many roulettes struggle with this, but with random selection the risk still remains.

On a webcam site everything is more predictable. The age of the models is confirmed by documents, and they go on air by their own decision. Previews, room descriptions and tip menus are visible even before entering. Didn't like it? You close the tab, and no one is offended. The usual rules of caution apply: do not disclose personal data and do not use third-party messengers. Read more about them in the guide about anonymity.

You control what you watch

In the roulette of your interlocutor, you are given a queue: press the button and get the one who happens to be there. Sometimes you have to scroll through dozens of people until you come across someone interesting, and each time the conversation starts from scratch.

On a webcam site, you choose. Broadcasts are divided into categories, there are filters by language, appearance and broadcast format, and you can save your favorite models to your favorites and visit them again. Over time, familiar faces and an understandable format appear. How to use these tools is described in the model selection guide.

The time is also different. In roulette, a conversation can end in five seconds if the other person clicks “next.” The model’s broadcast lasts for hours: you can come in, leave and come back whenever it’s convenient.

Disadvantages of webcam

The webcam site also has its disadvantages, which are not suitable for everyone:

  • This is a show and the model works here. Even very warm communication with her is not like a chance meeting of two people.
  • In popular rooms, attention is shared by everyone. When there are hundreds of viewers on air, you can wait a long time for an answer.
  • Public viewing is free, but private shows and actions from the tip menu are paid for with tokens.

If you are switching from roulette

Video chat habits in a model’s room don’t always work. Some tips to make your first time enjoyable:

  1. The model broadcasts for the entire room, so you shouldn’t wait for her to talk to you personally. Say hello in chat and she will respond when she notices the message.
  2. If the model is busy with another viewer, do not try to “switch” her. Open another broadcast for now and come back here later.
  3. Rules and prices are usually described in the room description. Read it, and you won’t have to ask almost anything.
  4. Unclear words in the chat can be looked up in the webcam dictionary.

When to choose what

  • Chat Roulette is suitable if...

    you want to chat with new people on equal terms, practice a foreign language or find friends with similar interests. This format was invented for casual dating, and it copes well with them.

  • A website is suitable if...

    you want to watch adult broadcasts, remaining behind the scenes, choose broadcasts yourself and be sure that all participants are adults and are there of their own free will.

/gid/anonimnost/.body:
Why does the viewer need anonymity

Anonymity on Stripchat is a common practice for most viewers. Few people want their hobbies to be related to work email, a social network page, or the family computer. Maintaining privacy is easy if you follow a few simple rules from day one.

You can watch public broadcasts without an account at all. Until you write in the chat, the model does not see you and does not know who entered the room. There is a separate guide about this mode about viewing without registration.

Your nickname: the first thing people learn about you

If you decide to create an account, start with your username. The model and other viewers only see that username.

  • It is better not to indicate your real name, surname and year of birth in your nickname, even in abbreviated form.
  • A nickname from games, forums or work chats is also not suitable: it can be easily found by searching.
  • The name of the city, company or phone number in your nickname will give you away just as quickly.
  • Good option: a neutral word and a couple of numbers.

Separate email and strong password

It is convenient to have a separate mailbox for entertainment sites. Then registration letters and notifications will not be sent to your main email, where they may be accidentally seen by one of your loved ones or colleagues.

  • You need your own password for your account, which is not used anywhere else. The easiest way to store it is in a password manager.
  • If you have two-factor authentication in your settings, enable it.
  • Unnecessary mailings and notifications in your profile can be disabled.
  • When several people use the computer, log out of your account after the session or create a separate browser profile.

How to create an account step by step is described in the registration guide.

Payment without unnecessary attention

Many people are concerned about how token purchases look on their bank statements. Large webcam services usually write a neutral company name in payment documents instead of the site name. The exact wording depends on the payment method and payment provider, so before making your first purchase, check the help section on the site itself.

The following tips are suitable for any platform:

  • pay only on the balance top-up page inside your account, do not trust links from chat or letters;
  • on a shared device, do not save card data in the browser;
  • Determine in advance the amount you are willing to spend and buy tokens in batches.

Ways to top up your balance are discussed in the material how to buy tokens.

What not to say in chat

Even if you have a warm relationship with the model, the chat remains a public place. A private show also does not guarantee that what is said will not go anywhere. Keep these details to yourself:

  • real name, address, place of work and telephone number;
  • links to your pages on social networks and instant messengers;
  • photos by which you can be recognized;
  • card data, codes from SMS and passwords.

When using your camera in cam-to-cam mode, check what is visible in the frame. Documents on the table, the view from the window, or conspicuous furniture can tell more about you than you would like. Many people point the camera so that their faces are not visible, and there is nothing strange about this.

Small details also add up to the picture. The phrase “I work in a bank” or “I live by the sea” does not mean anything in itself. But a few of these details plus a nickname that matches social networks, and the person can already be identified.

Traces on the device

Privacy also depends on your computer or phone. If someone else is using the device, you should take care of the little things:

  • Open the site in incognito mode or in a separate browser profile so that history and cookies do not mix with the main ones;
  • refuse push notifications if your browser offers them: the message on the lock screen can be read by anyone;
  • do not bookmark the site in the general panel and do not store the password in the family browser;
  • if your phone doesn’t have a screen lock, set it.

How to recognize scammers

Scammers target viewers of webcam sites because they hope that the victim will be afraid of publicity. Their patterns are repeated, and they are easy to recognize:

  • Offer to switch to messenger

    The “model” promises a discount and invites you to continue communication in another application. Outside the platform, you are not protected by anything, and anyone can write to you.

  • Phishing links

    You receive an email or message asking you to “verify your account” or pick up “free tokens,” and the link opens a fake login page. Check the address and do not enter a password on a site that you reached via someone else’s link.

  • Transfer requests

    Money is asked to be transferred to a card, cryptocurrency or gift certificates, bypassing the website. A legitimate model only accepts support from tokens on the platform.

  • Threats and blackmail

    If you are threatened with publicity, do not pay and stop correspondence. Save your messages and contact the platform's support team, and also contact the police.

Support never asks for a password or code from SMS. If someone does this on behalf of the service, you are dealing with a scammer.

Watch at your own pace

With these rules, you can safely watch broadcasts, communicate and support models without risking your personal data. Models, by the way, also protect their privacy. Don't try to find out their real names or find them on social networks: when both parties respect each other's boundaries, everyone feels more comfortable communicating.

For starters, free viewing is enough, and you can create an account whenever you want to write to the chat.

{{cta}}

    Public broadcast is shown in the same quality as for paying viewers. The only difference is whether you can influence what happens.

    You don’t need a card to register. Until you buy tokens yourself, there is simply nowhere to write them off.

  • “Free only at night”

    Models live in different time zones, so the broadcasts go on around the clock and there is always someone on air.

If the connection is weak, you can lower the quality in the player, if there is such a setting, or switch to Wi-Fi. The viewing itself is free, and the traffic is paid to the operator according to your tariff.

When it makes sense to spend money

Many people have been watching only for free for years, and there is nothing wrong with that. It’s worth spending money when you want something specific: to thank the model for a good mood, order an item from her menu, or chat one-on-one. Before your first purchase, understand how tokens work and what they are spent on so that the money is not wasted on random clicks.

If in doubt, it is better not to pay. Free broadcasts are here to stay, and it’s better to think about the purchase calmly before you get carried away by the common goal in the room.

What is available to the guest

  • Public broadcasts. The main reason why people come to a webcam site is open without an account.
  • Catalog and filters: models can be searched by categories, language and broadcast format.

In individual rooms and sections, the platform may prompt the guest to register or disable some functions. These restrictions change from time to time, so something may look a little different to someone you know.

Pros of guest browsing

Guest mode is good primarily for its privacy. Since there is no account, there is no email attached to the webcam site, notifications do not arrive, and it is impossible to accidentally buy something. Convenient if you just want to see what Stripchat is all about or visit occasionally.

Even fewer traces will remain if you open the site in an incognito tab: after closing, the browser will not save history and cookies. Other techniques are collected in the guide about anonymity.

Guest on shared device

If someone else uses the computer or tablet, guest mode is especially helpful. The account could remain open, and a notification about your favorite model would pop up at the worst possible moment. This will not happen to a guest. You still have to do a few things yourself:

  • look in a private tab and close it when finished;
  • do not save the site in bookmarks or on the main screen of your phone;
  • check if the browser synchronizes history with other devices under your account;
  • remember that after the regular tab, the address bar may suggest the site address, so open private mode every time.

All this takes seconds, and there will be no awkward situations afterwards.

When to create an account

Look at the list. If there are at least two points about you, registration will most likely pay off in convenience:

  1. Favorite models have appeared, and I want to know when they go on air.
  2. I would like to ask the model a question or at least say hello.
  3. You visit the site several times a week, and you’re tired of looking for the same people again every time.
  4. You don't rule out sending a tip or trying a private show one day.
  5. I would like the settings to be saved between visits.

If you visit once a month and all you have to do is watch, guest mode is quite enough.

You can remain a guest. Favorites and notifications are of no use to you, and without an account there are no letters or unnecessary traces. Public broadcasts are available in their entirety.

This is where your account will come in handy. Without a favorite, the model will have to be searched by nickname every time, and you will only find out about her broadcast by accident. Registration takes a couple of minutes and costs nothing.

There’s no way to do this without an account, because all paid actions go through the balance of tokens. There is no need to buy anything that same evening. Register, chat, shop around and pay when you know what you want.

Intermediate option: account without purchases

There is a middle ground between a guest and a paying viewer: a free account with no associated payment. Chat, favorites and notifications are available with it, and you don’t need to spend a single ruble. Many people use Stripchat this way: they look, communicate and start paying only when a specific desire arises.

/gid/chaevye/.body:
What is a tip on Stripchat

Tips on Stripchat are tokens that the viewer sends to the model directly during the broadcast. Public broadcasting remains free, and you pay for a specific action, for a request, or simply as a thank you for a good mood.

The model earns money in the general chat mainly from tips, and with their help the viewer can influence what happens on the air. Everyone can see the submission: a line with your nickname and amount appears in the chat, and the model usually responds personally. If it is not yet clear what kind of internal currency this is and how to top it up, first look at the guide about tokens.

Tip menu: price list directly on the screen

Almost every model has a tip menu, that is, a list of actions with prices in tokens. It is displayed next to the video or attached to the room description. The items can be very different: say your name, dance to the selected song, change clothes, turn on a toy for a few seconds or answer a question.

A few tips to avoid awkwardness with the menu:

  • Read carefully. Items with the same name in different models have different meanings and mean different things, and each model performs them according to its own rules.
  • Send exactly the amount indicated. Many models set up an automatic response to a certain number of tokens, and if you send more tokens, another item will work or nothing at all.
  • If something is not on the menu, you can ask politely, but you cannot demand it. The model has the right to refuse and not explain anything.
  • Wait a little. When someone else has already sent a tip before you, your item will be fulfilled next.

Goals: a common goal for the whole room

A goal is a token target that a model sets during a stream. Usually this is a certain amount of tokens, after which the promised show will begin. Progress is visible on the bar above the video or in the description line, and any viewer can contribute their part.

The convenience of a goal is that you don’t have to pay the entire amount to one person: five people little by little give the same amount as one generous guest. A couple of details worth knowing:

  • Sometimes goals come one after another, and the description of the next one appears only when the current one is closed.
  • If the goal is still far away, and the broadcast will end soon, the show may be postponed. When it's important to you, ask in chat.
  • Tokens sent to a goal will not be returned, even if the goal is not reached.

How much to give and when

There is no correct amount. One viewer will send a couple of tokens in response to a smile, another will save up for a big goal. Follow your budget and don’t follow others, because there will always be someone in the chat who spends more.

When tipping is especially appropriate:

  • the model fulfilled your request from the tip menu or answered the question in detail;
  • you sat in the room for a long time, and you felt good there;
  • the broadcast has just started, there are few people yet, and your support is easy to notice;
  • the goal is missing quite a bit, and your contribution will fill it.

When you want one-on-one attention, it can be more profitable to immediately go to a private show than to send a tip a little at a time. There the payment is per minute, and all this time the model is engaged only with you.

How not to overspend

Live broadcast is captivating, and you can send tokens in a second. To prevent the evening from ending in an unpleasant surprise, keep a few rules in mind:

  1. Determine in advance how much you are willing to spend per session, and buy a package of tokens for this amount. It’s not worth purchasing in small portions during the broadcast.
  2. If a model or other viewers pressure you to tip, you do not owe them anything.
  3. Check the amount before sending. It's especially easy to miss a button on a phone.
  4. Free viewing is also a normal option: you can watch and write in chat without spending a single token.

How to safely top up your balance is described in the guide about purchasing tokens.

Common mistakes of beginners

  • Tip in advance for promises. If there is no item in the menu and your request is answered with “tokens first”, find out the conditions before sending a large amount.
  • Dispatching when the model has moved away. The tokens will arrive, but you will have to wait for a response, so first make sure that the model is in the frame and looking into the chat.
  • Confusion between goal and menu. The amount “just like that” usually goes to the current goal and the menu item does not launch. Check the room description.
  • Expectation of special treatment. They thank you with tips; they can’t buy friendship. A model can highlight a generous guest, but she has no obligations.

Tipping and good manners

Sent tokens do not give the right to be rude. The model is the hostess of her room: she sets the rules, can refuse a request and block an intrusive guest, no matter how many he sends. A polite message along with tokens always works better than requirements.

Do not transfer money to models or “their managers” outside the site. Tips are sent only through the balance of tokens on the platform: then you have a history of transactions and there is support to contact. More information about protecting your data is written in the guide about anonymity.

Select a room, open the tip menu and watch how the model responds to tips from other guests. It will become clear pretty quickly what you like.

/gid/chto-takoe-vebkam/.body:
Webcam: what is it in a nutshell

Webcam: what is it without the jargon? Models broadcast live video from their webcam, and viewers watch them in a browser and chat with them. The word comes from the English webcam, so in the search you can also find “webcom what is it”. This means the same thing.

The easiest comparison is with the streams many people watch for games and music. The difference is that these platforms are intended for adults. Broadcasts can be explicit, so viewers must be at least 18 and models undergo age verification. But explicit content is not the whole format: many broadcasts focus on conversation, dancing, games with the chat or simply pleasant company in the evening.

Who participates: model, viewer, platform

  • Model

    An adult who decides when to go live and what to show. The model also sets the room rules, prices and show format.

  • The viewer

    Watches the broadcast, writes in the chat, can thank the model with a tip or order a personal show. He doesn’t need a camera: only his nickname is visible in the chat.

  • Platform

    The website through which all this works. He transmits videos, checks models, accepts payments, keeps order and resolves disputes.

How webcam works in practice

The path from the model’s camera to your screen is as follows:

  1. The model starts the broadcast, and her room appears in the catalog with a live thumbnail, description and tags.
  2. Viewers find broadcasts through categories and filters. The public part can be watched for free.
  3. There is a conversation in the chat: viewers write, the model responds by voice or text and reacts to questions and jokes.
  4. Whoever wants to participate more actively sends a tip: as a thank you, for an item from the model’s menu, or for the general purpose of the broadcast.
  5. You can invite the model to a private show. There, communication is one-on-one, and payment is per minute.

Everything happens in real time and depends on who is in the room now. Today the broadcast can be a calm conversation, and tomorrow the same model will have a noisy party with games. How to understand all this for the first time is described in detail in the guide for beginners.

How does a webcam differ from a regular adult video

The recording looks the same for everyone who turned it on, and does not react to the viewer in any way. In a webcam, you can ask a question and hear the answer in a few seconds, suggest a topic for conversation, or join the general game of the room. The model monitors the chat and adjusts the broadcast to the mood of the audience. Many viewers value webcams primarily for this feeling of live presence and contact with the person on the other side of the screen.

Tokens and what webcam sites are based on

Almost all large platforms operate on internal currency, tokens or loans. The viewer buys a package in advance, and then spends it on the site in small amounts: for tips, private shows, tickets to the show. You don't have to enter your card details for every action. How this currency works is described in the guide about tokens.

The economy here is simple. When a viewer spends tokens, the model receives part of the amount, and part remains for the site for infrastructure, payment protection and support. Each site has its own proportion and depends on the conditions of a particular model. There are also independent affiliate sites on the market like stripchat.su. They talk about the platform and show its broadcasts, and the platform pays them for referring users. This has nothing to do with the viewer: prices and rules are set by the site itself.

A little history

The first sites with broadcasts from home webcams appeared in the late 1990s, when cameras became affordable for ordinary users. The picture was then updated in jerks, and correspondence took place in separate windows. When fast Internet spread, the video became smooth, and the chat moved right into the broadcast window.

Gradually, what seems familiar today appeared: free public broadcasts, payment with tokens, a tipping menu and general goals. Later, mobile versions, high-quality videos, interactive toys that respond to tips, and broadcasts for VR helmets were added. At the core it is still a living person on the air and a conversation with him.

Webcam for adults: basic rules

Serious platforms follow several principles on which adult webcams are based:

  • Only 18+. Models confirm their age with documents, and spectators are allowed entry from 18 years old.
  • Voluntariness. The model decides what to do on air and can refuse any request.
  • Borders. Each room has its own rules, and if they are violated, you will be blocked.
  • Live broadcast. The broadcast is happening right now, it was not recorded in advance and was not edited.

Webcams should not be confused with a dating service or chat roulette. You won’t be matched with a random interlocutor here: you choose whose show to come to. The difference between the formats is discussed in detail in the material about the alternative to chat roulette.

Safety for those just getting started

To make your first acquaintance with a webcam go smoothly, basic caution is enough:

  • enter the platform directly or via a verified link and look at the address in the browser bar;
  • you can take your time with registration and purchases; free viewing is enough to understand the format;
  • Come up with a nickname that is not related to your name, and do not talk about yourself in the chat;
  • don’t pay anyone outside the site, no matter how convincing the request may sound.

More tips about privacy in the anonymity guide. And the easiest way to understand what a webcam is is to watch a couple of broadcasts yourself.

/gid/etiket/.body:
Why do we need etiquette

Webcam chat etiquette is not just for show. The model's room is both her workplace and a small community of spectators. When the chat is calm and friendly, the model feels freer, the show is livelier, and you get more attention, even if you haven't spent a single token.

The rules of communication on Stripchat are much the same as common courtesy in any online community. There are also some peculiarities, and it is useful to know them in advance, especially if you are just starting.

First minutes in the room

  1. Read the room description and pinned messages. Usually the model writes its rules, tip menu and current goal there.
  2. Just observe for a couple of minutes: what language they speak, what the mood is, who the moderators are.
  3. Say hello briefly, addressing the model by name. Enough with the usual “hello, how are you?”
  4. Didn't answer right away? Don't repeat the greeting ten times, because she can read dozens of messages at the same time.

What models value

  • Live conversation

    Ask about the music in the background, about a hobby, or about how your day went. Models hear the same type of requests all the time, and they are happy to have a normal interlocutor.

  • Compliments without vulgarity

    Note a smile, outfit, interior or sense of humor. A specific compliment will be remembered better than a general one.

  • Patience

    If a model is performing a menu item for another viewer or responding to someone in a private show, wait your turn.

  • Gratitude

    Say “thank you” after an answer or show. You can add tip, but even without them, gratitude will be in place.

What is considered rude

For some things, a model or moderator will block you without hesitation, even if you were just joking:

  • demands instead of requests: “show”, “do”, “come quickly” without context and without tokens are read as an order;
  • spam, that is, the same message many times, a continuous capslock or a stream of emoticons;
  • negative remarks about the figure, age, skin or voice (if you don’t like the model, it’s easier to move to another room);
  • questions about personal information: real name, city, address, social networks, offers to meet;
  • bargaining over prices in the tip menu or for private shows, because the prices are set by the model;
  • comparisons like “but that model is cheaper”, which do not inspire anyone;
  • Advertise your channels and links to third-party sites in someone else’s room.

The boundaries of the model are the law of the room

Each model has its own list of what it does and doesn't do. It is written in the profile, in the tip menu or spoken on air. If the model said no, the topic is closed. Don’t persuade, don’t offer to “double the amount” and don’t start the same conversation ten minutes later.

The same rule applies in private shows. By paying for private show, you get the model’s time and attention, and her rules continue to apply. Anything that is not included in its format is not worth discussing.

The model has the right to end the show, kick out the viewer or block him without explaining anything. This is part of her job, and there is nothing to be offended about.

How to say the same thing politely

Sometimes a rude message differs from a pleasant one in just a couple of words. Here are some examples:

InsteadBetter this way
“Show me a dance”“Will you dance something? Ready to send a la carte”
“Why don’t you answer??”“Hello! I see a lot of messages, I’ll wait.”
“Expensive”Don’t write anything and choose what you can afford
“Let’s go to messenger”“When is your next broadcast?”

Communicate with other viewers

Dozens of people are sitting in a popular room at the same time, and they are also worth taking into account. Don't argue in the general chat, don't laugh at other people's messages, and don't brag about your tips. If someone behaves ugly, do not get into a fight, the moderators and the model will deal with him. As a last resort, you can report the user or add him to ignore.

Etiquette in a private show

In a private show, communication becomes personal, but the basic rules do not go away. Here's what to remember:

  • Start with a couple of phrases about your mood. This makes it easier for both to relax and tune in to each other.
  • Say your wishes in advance. It’s more convenient for a model when it can immediately confirm that this is included in its format.
  • Keep an eye on the time. Privat is paid per minute, and you will have to calculate your budget yourself; the model is not obliged to remind you of this.
  • Don't record the show. Recording and distributing broadcasts without the consent of the model violates the rules of the platforms and her right to privacy.
  • Say goodbye. A simple “thank you, it was a pleasure” leaves a good impression, and next time you will be greeted as an acquaintance.

Language of communication

Models from different countries usually understand English, and many also understand Russian. In a foreign language, write in simple short phrases, they are easier to read and translate. If you want to communicate in your native language without any barriers, take a look at the Russian models section.

You can use an online translator, just re-read the result: machine translation sometimes turns a harmless phrase into an ambiguous one. If the model does not understand you, reformulate it more simply, and do not repeat it with a capslock. And don't be offended if she answers in her own language. Many models read better than they write.

Walk into the room, say hello and ask the model something. One polite message is enough for a good acquaintance.

Two ways to spend the evening

AI erotic chat and live webcam model at first glance provide the same thing: an interlocutor with whom you can flirt and talk about adult topics. The difference between them is big. In one case, an algorithm answers you, in another, a real person. Below is a comparison without advertising of specific services: what each format offers, what risks it has and who it is suitable for.

If you are not yet familiar with webcam, start with the guide what is webcam. This page is about how to choose between it and AI chat for adults.

How the erotic chat bot works

The chatbot for adults works on a language model that has been pre-specified as a character: character, appearance, manner of speech. You write, the program generates a response, and it sounds natural, adapting to your tone. Some services add generated pictures or a synthesized voice to the text.

Such an interlocutor does not have his own desires or boundaries, there are only restrictions from the developers. He is always online, never gets tired and almost never refuses. For some this is convenient, but for others this is precisely what is missing in live communication. You just have to remember that behind the answers there are statistics of words, there is no personality there.

The man on the other side of the screen

A webcam model is an adult who has verified their age and chosen to go live. They have their own mood, sense of humor, rules and the right to refuse any request. This makes a broadcast unpredictable: a joke may or may not land, the conversation can go in any direction, and the reaction is genuine.

Many people appreciate just this. A compliment from a living person is perceived differently than from a program that is supposed to be nice. In return, they expect simple politeness from you; there is a guide about it on chat etiquette. If conversation is what you're most interested in, check out this selection of models who focus on communication.

Comparison by points

CriterionAI chat for adultsLive webcam model
InterlocutorProgram with a given characterReal person 18+
ReactionPredictable, always agreeableAlive, with its own character
AvailabilityAny timeWhen the model is on air
VideoNone or generated imagesLive from camera
BoundariesSpecified by the developersSpecified by the model itself
PaymentUsually subscription or message limitsFree viewing, paid tips and private shows

Different services pay differently, so the table shows the general principle without prices.

Privacy: where do your words go

This is most often forgotten. The AI chat runs on the company’s servers, and every message goes there. Before you speak out, find out:

  • does the service store correspondence and for how long?
  • is it possible to delete the entire history and account;
  • are conversations used to train models or shared with third parties?
  • who is behind the service and in which country it operates.

The situation is different in webcam chat. Messages in the public room are seen by the model and other viewers, and the broadcast itself can be watched even without an account. One rule applies to both formats: do not give your real name, city or place of work, and do not send personal photos. How to maintain privacy is described in detail in the guide about anonymity.

Money

AI services typically sell subscriptions or message packages. Costs remain predictable until you start purchasing additional features. On the webcam platform, you can watch public broadcasts for free, even for years, and pay only when you yourself want to thank the model or invite her to a private show. In both cases, it is convenient to set yourself a monthly limit in advance and stick to it.

Subscriptions to AI chats have one more subtlety. Before paying, check how to turn off renewals and how the payment will appear on your bank statement. On the webcam platform, money is spent through the internal currency, and it is better to figure out how to replenish it in advance. Details in the guide about tokens.

Emotional side

It’s easy to get used to the AI interlocutor. He is always there, always attentive and remembers what you told yesterday. It will brighten up a lonely evening, but it can also take the place of a real relationship. If you notice that you're looking forward to talking to a bot more than meeting people, it makes sense to take a break.

With a live model, the emotions are real, and yet you shouldn’t lose your head. The model is at work, and warmth on air is part of her profession; she does not promise personal intimacy. When both parties remember this boundary, communication is more pleasant.

What to choose

For queries like “AI webcam” or “strip chat with artificial intelligence,” people sometimes look for something in between the two formats. But these are still different genres, and there is no need to mix them. AI chat is suitable if you want to fantasize in correspondence at any time and you don’t mind that the interlocutor is not real. Live broadcasts are chosen by those who value a real reaction, voice, look and the feeling that there is someone on the other side of the screen.

The second option is easy to check: the public broadcasts below are open for free and without registration.

/gid/kak-kupit-tokeny/.body:
Before you buy

Buying tokens on Stripchat is no more difficult than making any purchase on the Internet. There are, however, things specific to a webcam platform: confidentiality of payment, package size, and the temptation to buy “a little more.” This guide breaks down how everything works so that you pay with your eyes open.

If it is not yet clear why internal currency is needed and what it is spent on, first look at the guide about tokens. To purchase, you need an account, and how to create one is described in the registration instructions.

How the purchase goes

The buttons and design of the payment page change periodically, but the overall order is as follows:

  1. Login to your account and open your balance replenishment. Usually an item in the profile menu or a button next to the current balance leads there.
  2. Select a package. The platform will show you how many tokens you will receive and how much it is worth in your currency.
  3. Choose one of the payment methods available in your country.
  4. Enter your payment details on a secure page and, if the bank sends you a code, confirm the payment.
  5. After payment, tokens will appear on your balance, usually within a few seconds. If they are missing for a long time, refresh the page.
Pay only on the platform page itself. Offers of “cheaper tokens” in chat or private messages and requests to transfer money to a card come from scammers.

How to select a package

Larger packages are usually more profitable per token, and the platform is happy to remind you of this. However, saving makes sense if you actually spend these tokens. For the first time it is better to take a smaller package. This will make it clear how quickly your balance is used up, how much the formats you are interested in cost, and whether you need it at all.

Figure out in advance what the tokens will be used for. A couple of tips per evening and regular private shows with a per-minute fee require very different amounts. Look at the prices of the models you like and calculate from them.

If the payment does not go through

With foreign services, payment refusals happen often, and the platform is not always to blame. The bank may prohibit international payments or transactions of a certain category, there may not be enough money in the account taking into account the commission, and sometimes the confirmation code simply does not arrive. What you can do:

  • Check your banking application: there may be a notification about a rejected transaction with a reason.
  • Check whether online payments and purchases from foreign sellers are allowed with the card.
  • Try another payment method from the balance top-up page.
  • Do not repeat the attempt dozens of times in a row, otherwise the bank may temporarily block the card as suspicious.

Payment confidentiality

Many people are worried about what their relatives or accounting department will see in the statement. Webcam platforms usually process payments through payment companies, and the statement contains a neutral name without mentioning Stripchat or the subject of the site. The name under which the payment will be processed is usually written on the payment page, so read it before confirming.

What else helps maintain privacy:

  • separate mail for your account, where receipts and purchase notifications will be sent;
  • disabled advertising mailings in account settings;
  • habit of logging out of your account and closing the site on a shared device.

How to leave no traces is described in detail in the anonymity guide.

How to keep spending under control

Live communication is exciting, and tokens are spent unnoticed, especially when a common goal is collected in the chat. In order not to regret your purchases later, several habits help:

  • Monthly limit

    Decide an amount that you don’t mind spending on entertainment, and don’t go beyond it. If the limit is over, watch for free until next month.

  • Without a saved map

    It takes a little longer to enter data manually, and this is often enough. While you are looking for a map, the impulse has time to cool down.

  • Separate card

    Some people keep a separate or virtual card from their bank with a small balance for entertainment. It simply won’t be possible to spend more than planned.

  • Pause before repurchase

    If the tokens run out in the middle of the ether, delay the replenishment for at least ten minutes. Often the desire passes during this time.

If you find yourself spending more than you can afford or can't stop, take a break. Webcam is intended as entertainment, and it should not hurt your wallet.

If something goes wrong

It happens that the tokens did not arrive, the payment went through twice, or the statement contains a debit that you did not make. The procedure is as follows:

  1. Check your account balance and purchase history. Sometimes enrollment is simply late.
  2. Write down the details: date, amount and transaction number from the letter or banking application.
  3. Write to platform support via the form on the website and calmly, point by point, describe what happened.
  4. If you suspect that the card data has reached strangers, immediately block it at the bank.

Refunds are decided according to the rules of the platform, and it all depends on the situation. It’s usually not worth going straight to the bank to cancel the payment without writing to support: the account may be blocked while they sort it out. First, support, and a bank in case the issue has not been resolved.

/gid/kak-vybrat-model/.body:
Where to start choosing

Choosing a model on Stripchat can be difficult precisely because of the abundance. There are a lot of online broadcasts at any time, and half an hour is easily spent scrolling through the previews. Here are ways to narrow your search and quickly find the broadcast you like.

Before opening filters, it is useful to understand a couple of things for yourself. Are you more interested in a conversation or a show? What language do you want to communicate in? Are you ready to spend tokens, or will viewing be enough for now? The answers determine what to look at first.

Filters and categories

Filters cut off the excess quickly. Models can be selected by appearance, age group (all models are strictly adults), country, language and broadcast format. The set of filters changes from time to time, but the principle is the same: the more precise the request, the shorter the list.

If you don’t want to bother with filters, start with ready-made selections in the category catalog. For example:

  • new models, who are often especially attentive to the audience;
  • models with interactive toys, if you like to influence the show with tips;
  • couples, themed shows, cosplay or dances when a specific format is needed.

Language matters

Many viewers come to webcams for the sake of communication, and then language becomes decisive. A model who understands you without a translator, jokes back and keeps the conversation going is usually more interesting than the most impressive but silent model.

Language can be found:

  • in the model’s profile, in the field with the languages spoken;
  • in the name or description of the room;
  • in the chat, based on how viewers write and how the model responds.

At the same time, pay attention to how the model communicates: by voice or only by text. Some are willing to speak out loud and answer questions, others play music and write briefly in the chat. If a live voice is important to you, this will become clear within a couple of minutes.

When a profile lists multiple languages, the native one is usually listed first. Almost everyone understands English, but for fluent conversation it is better to look for a match in your native language.

What to look for in the room

The preview shows only the picture. To understand whether this is your model, open the air and sit there for a few minutes. It is convenient to evaluate based on the following criteria:

  • Picture and sound quality

    Good light, stable video and clear sound usually mean that the model takes its work seriously.

  • Reaction to chat

    See if she responds to viewers, addresses them by name and carries on a conversation, or just looks at the camera.

  • Chat environment

    It’s more pleasant to sit in a calm, friendly chat with moderators than in the middle of spam and demands.

  • Tip menu and goal

    The menu shows what format the model offers and how much it costs. If nothing from there interests you, look further.

  • Profile description

    Many models write there about themselves and their interests, about the rules of the room and schedule.

Popularity, ratings and favorites

The number of spectators in the room indicates popularity, but it may not suit your taste. When there are a thousand people in the room, the model physically does not have time to answer everyone, and in a small broadcast there are much more chances for a normal conversation.

More useful is your own rating, that is, a list of favorites. Add everyone you like even a little there, and in a week you will see who you return to more often. Favorites open after free registration, and then the site will be able to show which of your models is currently on air.

The time of day also affects the choice

Models live in different time zones, and different people are on air throughout the day. Some are online in the morning and afternoon in Moscow, others are online late in the evening. If your favorite model goes on air while you are at work, it makes sense to look for a similar one whose schedule coincides with your free time.

A couple of practical tips:

  • visit the same category at different times to get an idea of who is usually online during your hours;
  • look at the profile, some models indicate the days and times of broadcasts there;
  • please note that during peak hours the rooms are crowded, and during quiet times the model can pay more attention to each viewer.

Look before you pay

Do not waste tokens on a model you see for the first time. Public broadcasts on Stripchat are free, so you can take a closer look first.

  1. Watch the public broadcast for at least ten to fifteen minutes.
  2. Write a couple of messages in the chat and see how the model responds.
  3. If you liked it, send a small tip and watch the reaction.
  4. After that, it makes sense to consider a private show or a larger goal.
You liked the model, but there’s no time for it now? Add it to your favorites. There are good broadcasts every day, there is no rush.

Look for yours

If “the same” model was not found the first time, it’s okay. Sometimes it takes a couple of evenings to understand what is closer to you: calm conversational broadcasts, fun rooms with goals or interactive shows. Save everyone you are interested in as favorites, and then remove those you don’t return to.

Tastes change over time. Sometimes look into unfamiliar categories; there are often unexpected favorites there. If you come across unclear terms in your profiles, look them up in webcam dictionary.

{{cta}}

/gid/ne-zagruzhaetsya/.body:
First determine what exactly is not working

If Stripchat won't load, it's most often the browser or connection that's to blame, and you can fix it in a couple of minutes. Check everything in order and do not change several settings at once, otherwise it will not be clear what exactly helped.

Start with a symptom, it shows which step you should start with:

What you seeProbable causeWhere to start
The page opened, but instead of a video there is an empty block or a black screenAd or script blocker, outdated browserSteps 1 and 2
Video takes forever to load or constantly freezesInternet speed, quality is too highSteps 4 and 5
The site looks “broken”, the buttons do not workOld files in the browser cacheStep 3
Only one broadcast is not workingThe model has finished broadcasting or went privateOpen another broadcast
Does not work only on the phoneSaving traffic, mobile browserSection about phones below

Check by steps

Step 1. Update your browser

Video broadcasts work on modern web technologies, and older versions of browsers do not work well with them. Go to settings, open the “About Browser” section and install the update, if available. Then the browser needs to be restarted.

Step 2: Disable blockers for this page

Extensions against ads, trackers or scripts often mistake the built-in player for advertising and hide it. There is no need to remove the extension, just add the page to the exclusion list.

  1. Click on the extension icon next to the address bar.
  2. Select an option like “Do not block on this site” or “Pause on this page.”
  3. Reload the tab.

If your browser has built-in tracking protection, lower it for this site while checking. Settings are opened by the icon to the left of the address.

Step 3: Clear cache and cookies

To make the site open faster, the browser stores copies of its files. Over time, they become outdated, and the page begins to work crookedly. Try a hard reboot first: on a computer this is usually Ctrl+F5 or Ctrl+Shift+R, on a Mac the combination is Cmd+Shift+R. Didn't help? Clear your cache and cookies from the last few days in your privacy settings. After clearing cookies, you will have to log in to your account again.

Step 4. Check your Internet connection

  • Open another website with video. If it slows down there too, the problem is in the connection.
  • Reboot your router and wait half a minute before turning it on again.
  • Sit closer to the router or connect with a cable.
  • Pause background downloads, system updates, and other videos.

Step 5. Reduce broadcast quality

For high-definition broadcasts you need a fast and stable channel. The player usually has a gear or quality menu, where you can select a lower resolution. The picture will become a little softer, but the video will stop freezing. Broadcasts in HD It’s more convenient to watch via a stable home Internet.

Step 6: Try a different browser or device

If all else fails, open the page in another browser or on another device. So it quickly becomes clear where to look for the reason: if everything works in another browser, the problem is in the settings or extensions of the first one. You can also check in incognito mode, where extensions are usually disabled by default.

Phone features

Smartphones have their own reasons why broadcasts do not load:

  • Saving traffic in your browser or phone settings may compress or block the video. Turn it off for this site.
  • Energy saving limits background work and sometimes interferes with playback. You can turn it off while watching.
  • If the mobile signal is weak, switch to Wi-Fi or lower the video quality.
  • When memory is full, close unnecessary tabs and applications and restart the browser.

More tips on watching from a smartphone can be found on the page broadcasts from a phone.

There is video, but no sound

They also often complain about this: the picture works, but there is no sound. Usually nothing is broken, it's just a matter of settings:

  • Browsers play videos without sound until you click something on the page, so click on the speaker icon in the player;
  • look to see if the sound of the tab is muted (on a computer you can see a speaker icon on it, you can turn the sound on by right-clicking);
  • check that the system's sound is turned on and the desired output device is selected, such as headphones;
  • on your phone, look at the side switch for silent mode and media volume.

Some models broadcast with music or without sound at all, this is what they decided for themselves. If there is no sound in only one room, look in another.

If the problem persists

Sometimes a failure occurs on the side of the platform itself, and then you just have to wait and try later. If you have an account and the problem persists, write to the site's support service. Please indicate your device, browser and version, and describe what is happening.

Do not download “special players” and “accelerators” from third-party sites. A regular updated browser is enough for broadcasting, but such programs often turn out to be malicious. How to protect yourself is described in the guide about anonymity and security.

If you have gone through the entire list, try opening the broadcasts again.

{{cta}}

/gid/novichkam/.body:
What is Stripchat in simple words

Stripchat is a webcam platform where models broadcast live, and viewers watch them and chat with them in real time. In this guide for beginners, the site is disassembled from scratch: what happens here, what they pay for and how to navigate the first evening.

Stripchat differs from video sites in that everything is live. There is no recording, and there is no script either. The model reacts to viewers’ messages, answers questions, arranges games and sets goals, so yesterday’s and today’s broadcasts of the same model can be very different.

There are three types of viewers: guests without an account, registered users without purchases, and users with tokens. Their capabilities vary, but public broadcasts are open to everyone. What is available without payment is described in detail in the guide about free viewing.

First fifteen minutes on the site

You don’t have to rush with registration, and even more so with replenishing your balance. First, just look around:

  1. Open the list of broadcasts and scroll through it. The thumbnails are updated, and they show what is currently happening on the air.
  2. Go to two or three different broadcasts: a calm one, where the model chats with the audience, and a lively one, where the chat just flashes by.
  3. Understand how the room is organized: video window, chat, model information, as well as goals and a tip menu, if any.
  4. Monitor messages about tips in chat. They show how viewers interact with the model and what she offers.
  5. You will need your account when you want to write to the chat or save the model.

Such an acquaintance costs nothing, and half of the questions after it disappear on their own.

How to find a model to suit your taste

There are so many broadcasts going on simultaneously that there is no point in scrolling through them in a row. It is more convenient to use filters and categories: by appearance, age (18+ only), language and broadcast format. For Russian-speaking viewers, it is usually easier to start with models who speak Russian, then there is no need for a translator in the chat.

A couple of practical tips:

  • In addition to the thumbnail, read the profile description. Models write there what they like, what languages they speak and when they usually go on air.
  • You shouldn’t judge the quality by the number of viewers. In a small room, the model has time to respond to everyone, but in a popular room, your message can easily get lost.
  • New models are often especially willing to communicate, because they are just building an audience.
  • If you like the model, add it to your favorites (you need an account for this), and the site will tell you when it will go on air again.

Chat and communication with the model

Without chat, webcam does not work. The model reads the messages and responds by voice or text. To get noticed, simple things are enough: say hello, ask something on the topic, respond to what is happening on the air. A short “hi, where are you from?” works better than requirements and commands.

Each room has its own rules. Some models close the chat for guests or users without tokens, others ask not to capslock or spam. Before your first message, look at the room description. General standards of behavior are collected in the guide to webcam chat etiquette.

What you have to pay for if you want

Public broadcasts are free. You only have to pay if you want more: send the model a tip, choose an item from her menu, go to a private show, or buy a ticket to a special show. All this is paid for in internal currency, tokens, which are purchased in advance.

It is useful for a beginner to decide in advance how much he is willing to spend per evening, and not to top up his balance beyond this amount. Tokens are used up quickly, especially when the chat is captivating and everyone around is sending tips for a common goal.

{{cta}}

Frequent mistakes in the first week

  • Buy a large package of tokens at once. While it is not clear what you like, a large purchase almost always ends in unnecessary expenses. Start small or don't make any purchases at all.
  • Write command models. “Show” or “do” without a greeting most quickly leads to a ban in the room. The model is a living person, and you shouldn’t treat her like a menu.
  • Wait for a response to each message. In a busy room, the model physically does not have time to read everything, and if you are not noticed, the chat is simply too fast.
  • Believe “personal suggestions.” Cheap tokens, free private conversations or messaging in messenger for a fee usually turn out to be a scam.
  • Sit in the same room. Try different broadcasts, languages and formats: each model has its own style, and it’s not the first time you find your favorite ones.

Security and privacy from day one

  • Come up with a nickname that is not associated with your name, work or other accounts.
  • Do not give models and other spectators your phone number, address, place of work, or photos of documents.
  • Do not transfer money “directly”, bypassing the platform, even if asked to do so. Payments have support on Stripchat, but outside of it there will be no one to help.
  • Register only on the official page and create a password that is not used anywhere else.

If you decide that you still need an account, step-by-step instructions are in the registration guide. And if you just want to watch, scroll down the page, the broadcasts are already underway.

/gid/privat/.body:
Why are there so many formats

A private show on Stripchat is just one of several show formats. There are also public broadcasts, exclusive private shows, voyeurism mode, group and ticket shows. They differ in the composition of participants, who controls what is happening, and how tokens are written off. When you understand the difference, it’s easier to choose a format that suits your mood and budget.

Each model sets its own prices, so there will be no numbers in this guide. The cost of any format is visible in the room even before payment.

Public broadcast

It all begins with him. The broadcast is visible to everyone who logs in, and you can watch it for free. The model communicates with the chat, answers questions, completes items from the tip menu and collects common goals. Usually this is where you get to know it and decide whether you want to continue in a different format.

Private show

You send the model a request for a private show. If she accepts it, the public broadcast is closed for others. You pay by the minute: while the show is on, every minute the price assigned by the model is removed from the balance. It turns out to be a one-on-one conversation, and you can discuss what interests you, within the rules of the platform and the boundaries that the model said.

Keep in mind one thing: other viewers can enter a regular private chat in voyeur mode. They can't write or direct the show, but they watch. If this bothers you, take the exclusive.

Exclusive private show

The same private show, only without observers: you see the show alone. It usually costs more per minute because the model loses money on voyeurs. They take an exclusive when complete privacy and the full attention of the model are important, or when you want to talk calmly without the feeling that someone is standing behind the glass.

Peeping

This is an ordinary private conversation, seen from the outside. If the model is currently in a private show with another viewer, the observer can connect to him. As a rule, it costs less than your own privacy, but you won’t decide anything: you can’t write models and you can’t influence the course of the show either. The mode is useful if you first want to see how the model conducts private conversations, and then order your own.

Group show

The model announces a group show, the audience joins him. The required number of participants has been collected, and the show starts, and everyone pays for their place. It turns out cheaper than an individual private show, because the cost is actually divided among the whole group. There are also disadvantages: if there aren’t enough people, the show may never start, and the model’s attention gets to everyone at once.

Ticket show

The model announces such a show in advance and indicates the topic, approximate time and ticket price. You pay one time for admission and watch the entire show, without paying per minute. It’s convenient for the budget because you know the amount from the very beginning. Follow the announcement and start time, otherwise part of the show will take place without you.

What to expect from a private chat and what not to do

The main thing that a private show gives is the attention of the model. On public broadcast it is divided into tens and hundreds of viewers, but here it goes to you. You can calmly talk, ask for what interests you, and see the reaction to yourself personally. Many viewers go private primarily for the sake of conversation.

A private show still has boundaries. The model herself determines what she is ready to do, she can refuse a request or close the show if she is rude. The rules of the platform in private mode do not go away, and attempts to arrange a meeting, correspondence in instant messengers, or pay “over the counter” quickly end in blocking. And one more thing: a private show does not promise a “special relationship”. The model is friendly because this is her job. If you keep this in mind, you will save both your nerves and your wallet.

It happens that in the public air the model seems hasty or absent-minded, but in a private show she reveals itself completely differently. If you like the lively, noisy room itself, it may be better to stay on the public air and support the tip model.

Format comparison

FormatWho is watchingPaymentInfluence on the show
PublicAllFree, tips optionalThrough chat and tips
PrivateYou and observersMinuteFull
ExclusiveOnly youMinutely, more expensiveFull
PeepingObserverMinutely, cheaperNo
GroupGroup membersFor participationGeneral
TicketTicket holdersOne time per ticketLimited

How to choose a format and prepare

  1. First, watch the model on public air. A private chat with a person you have never seen is like a lottery, and a couple of minutes in a general chat will tell you a lot about the model. We discussed how to choose it in the guide about choosing a model.
  2. Check the price of a minute and estimate how many minutes your balance will last.
  3. If you have a modest budget, you should take a closer look at group and ticketed shows, where the final amount is clearer.
  4. Before the private conversation, write briefly in the chat what you want and ask if the model agrees. This way you will save minutes and avoid awkward pauses.

The rules of politeness in any format are the same as in the general chat. Respect the boundaries of the model, do not put pressure on her and do not try to take communication outside the platform. More information about this is written in the guide to etiket.

/gid/registraciya/.body:
What to prepare in advance

Registration on Stripchat is free and takes a couple of minutes. A couple of things should still be decided before pressing the button: which email to register with, which nickname to use and which password to set. It’s easier to choose right away than to change later.

  • Mail. Many people keep a separate mailbox for entertainment sites so that emails from the webcam platform do not end up in the same thread as work and family ones.
  • Password. It must be new, never used anywhere else. If you have a password manager, trust it to generate it.
  • Nickname. There is a separate section about it below: models and other viewers in the chat will recognize you by your nickname.

Registration step by step

The platform interface is sometimes updated, and the labels on the buttons may differ slightly. The procedure remains the same:

  1. Go to Stripchat and find the sign up button. As a rule, it appears at the top of the page and also pops up when a guest tries to write in the chat or add the model to favorites.
  2. Confirm that you are at least 18 years old. Otherwise, the platform will not let you continue.
  3. Enter a nickname. If it is taken, the system will offer to come up with another one.
  4. Enter your email and create a password.
  5. Read the terms of use and privacy policy. If you are satisfied with everything, complete the registration.
  6. Go to your email and confirm your address using the link in the email.

Sometimes the platform offers to log in through a third-party service. This is faster, but then the webcam account will be linked to your main profile. If privacy is important to you, register in the usual way, via email. For more tips on this topic, see on anonymity.

How to choose a nickname

When you write to the chat, the first thing the model sees is your nickname. It determines what impression you make and how secure your personal information is. Here's what you should pay attention to.

  • No personal information

    Do not put your first and last name, year of birth, city or company name in your nickname. The nickname by which you are known on social networks or games is also not suitable.

  • Easy to read

    Models often address the audience out loud. “NightOwl” or “Sever” are easy to pronounce, but with something like “xX_k1ll3r_2k_Xx” you will have to suffer.

  • No rudeness

    Vulgar and provocative nicknames of models are annoying, and in some rooms such viewers are immediately blocked.

  • For a long time

    Models remember regular viewers by their nickname. If you keep coming back to the same people, the name will gradually become part of your familiarity.

A simple way: take a word that is associated with a hobby or mood, and add something neutral to it. For example, "TeaLover", "QuietEvening" or "Orion". The Cyrillic alphabet is not always accepted in nicknames, so for a Russian name, come up with a Latin backup option in advance.

Email confirmation

Immediately after registration you will receive an email with a link. Until you click on it, some of the account functions may not work, and without a verified address, you will not be able to recover your password. If there is no letter for several minutes, do this:

  1. Look in the Spam, Promotions, and Mailings folders. Email providers love to hide letters from entertainment sites there.
  2. In your account settings, check whether the address is entered correctly. Most often it’s a matter of one extra or missing letter.
  3. Ask to send the letter again. This button is usually found on your profile or in a pop-up reminder.
  4. If this does not work, write to platform support using the form on the website.

Typical registration errors

  • Registration on a fake site. There are pages that copy the design of webcam platforms and collect passwords. Before entering data, look at the address in the browser bar.
  • Old password from email or social network. If a database leaks one day, this password will be tried on all sites in a row. There is no such problem with a unique password.
  • Work email. Emails from a cam site in a corporate inbox can easily turn into awkward questions.
  • Nick thought up in a second. It’s a shame to show a random set of letters in a chat, and you may not be able to change it.
  • Unverified email. If you forget your password, it is more difficult to recover such an account.

If you are not yet sure that you need an account at all, compare the options in the guide about viewing without registration.

What to do immediately after registration

Open your profile settings. There, unnecessary mailings and notifications are disabled, the interface language is selected and privacy is configured. Then add to your favorites a couple of models that caught your eye while you were watching as a guest. The site will let you know when they go live.

Separately, it is worth securing your login. If the platform offers additional confirmation upon login, turn it on. It will take a minute, and it will become much more difficult to take away an account with a balance of tokens. Store your password in a password manager, not in notes on your phone, and don’t log into your account from other people’s devices. If you had to sign in on someone else’s device, remember to sign out and close your browser. If it seems that someone has gained access, immediately change your password and look at your purchase history.

Before your first chat message, it's a good idea to review the etiquette rules to ensure you make a good impression from the start. If you want to support the model, you will need instructions on how to buy tokens calmly and within your budget.

faq.q: How is a private show different from a group show?
faq.a: In private, the model communicates only with you. A group show is paid for by several spectators at once, so it’s cheaper for everyone.

faq.q: What does “model in private” mean?
faq.a: The model is currently hosting a private show with another viewer, and the public broadcast has been stopped for the time being. If she has enabled spy mode, you can sometimes spy on the show.

faq.q: Why are tokens needed and not regular money?

Why do you need a dictionary

In webcam chat a beginner is most confused by the following words: “type”, “goal”, “spare”, “C2C”, “loves”. Almost all of them came from English and took root in Russian-speaking rooms, without translation. This webcam dictionary explains basic concepts in simple terms so you can understand what the model and other viewers are talking about.

Functions may be named differently on different platforms, and terms and conditions change over time. Therefore, general definitions are given here, and see the exact rules on the site itself.

Money and payment

TermWhat it means
TokensInternal currency of the site. They are bought in packages and spent on tips, private shows and other paid functions. More details in the guide about tokens.
Type, tipsTokens that the viewer sends to the model right during the broadcast. The word comes from the English tip, hence the verb “to tip.”
Tip menuList of model actions with prices in tokens: answer a question, dance, change image, and so on. Sent the amount from the menu, and the model executes this item.
GoalThe goal of the ether, that is, the amount of tokens, after collecting which the model shows the promised show. Any viewer can chip in, everyone can see the progress. How to work with the menu and goals is described in the guide about tipping.
TipperA viewer who sends a tip. The most generous models are often noted in the chat.

Types of shows

TermWhat it means
Public broadcastRegular broadcast, open to everyone. You can watch for free, and write to the chat after registration.
PrivateOne-on-one show with the model. Payment is per minute, in tokens, and other viewers do not see the conversation. Details in the guide about private shows.
Exclusive private showA private show option that cannot be viewed in spy mode, so only you can see the show. It usually costs more than a standard private show.
Spy modeThe ability to view someone else’s private show for tokens, without having the right to write in the chat. Works only if the private model and format allow it.
Group showA performance for which several spectators pay at once. It costs everyone less than personal private show, and the model performs for the entire group.
Ticket showTicket show. The viewer pays a fixed amount in advance and gets access to the performance at the appointed time.

Technology and interactive

TermWhat it means
Cum-tu-cam, C2CMode in which the model sees you through your camera. Most often it is available in a private show and is turned on only if you want it.
Lavens, lovensThis is how interactive toys are called in conversation, named after the famous manufacturer. They are connected to the ether, and they respond to tips: more tokens, stronger or longer reaction. Such broadcasts are collected in the category interactive toys.
VR broadcastBroadcast in virtual reality format. You can watch it in a VR helmet or in panorama mode.
HDBroadcast in high definition. It requires faster internet.

Account and community

TermWhat it means
FavoritesYour personal list of favorite models. It makes them easy to find and you can immediately see who is on air now.
Fan ClubPaid subscription for one specific model. As a rule, it gives access to restricted materials, a special icon in the chat and other bonuses that the model chooses herself.
Ultimate, premium subscriptionPaid subscription for the entire site, without reference to a separate model. Typically unlocks advanced features and privileges in chat, the exact set varies by platform.
Moderator, modA viewer whom the model entrusted to keep order in the chat. It can delete messages and restrict violators.
GuestViewer without an account or without purchased tokens. He can watch the broadcast, but in the chat his capabilities are limited.
DM, PMPrivate messages from the model, bypassing the general chat. Many services are not available to every user.

Model statuses

The broadcast preview and in the room itself often have a marker that makes it clear what is happening now. Signatures vary, but usually mean the following.

  • “Online”, “on air”: there is a public broadcast, come and watch.
  • “Private”, “group”: the model is busy with a paid show, and the public broadcast is still closed.
  • “Moved away”, “break”: the model briefly left the frame, the broadcast will continue soon.
  • “Offline”: no broadcast at the moment. If a model is in your favorites, you will know when it returns.
  • “New Model”: She recently started working on the platform. Viewers are usually happy with such newcomers.

Short phrases from chat

  • “In private” means that the model is busy with a private show and the public broadcast is paused.
  • “Goal is closed”: the amount has been collected, now the promised will begin.
  • “BRB” is written when the model moves away for a short time.
  • "PVT?" They ask if they can call the model privately.
  • Models write “Ty” (thank you) in gratitude for the tip.
  • “Np” stands for no problem, that is, “no problem” or “no problem.”
  • “Hi all”, “Hey guys”: this is how the model greets everyone who enters the room.
  • “Lurker” is a viewer who watches silently and does not write in the chat. There is nothing wrong with this, many people do this.
  • “Regular” means a regular viewer who often looks into the room. Models recognize such people and greet them by their nickname.
  • “Ban” and “kick” mean blocking a viewer from a room or removing it from it for violating the rules. How to avoid this is described in the guide on chat etiquette.
Meet an unfamiliar word in the chat? Politely ask the model or moderator. The question is quite common, and newcomers to the rooms are usually treated kindly.

With these words you can calmly enter any room and understand what is happening there.
