Where does a partner's income come from?

There is only one way to earn in Stripcash: to bring to Stripchat users who register and start using paid functions. The platform shares with the partner part of the revenue or pays for a certain action. The site, channel, advertising campaigns are needed exactly in order to find such users.

Keep in mind that you can watch broadcasts for free, so the click alone is worth nothing. Money appears when the person you bring buys tokens. It turns out that the number of transitions decides less than the willingness of your audience to pay. If you are not yet familiar with the program as a whole, start with affiliate review.

payment models: how they are arranged

Adult affiliate programs usually use two common payment models. Your Stripcash dashboard shows which are available to you and on what terms. Here, we explain only the general principle.

Revenue Share

The partner receives a percentage of what the given user spends on the service. If a person stays on the platform for a long time and regularly buys tokens, accruals all this time are under the terms of the program. This income is growing slowly. In the first weeks after launch, the amount is usually modest, and then a lot depends on the behavior of the audience, which you do not directly affect.

The scheme is well suited for SEO sites and channels that have been working for years and bringing loyal visitors.

Action Payment (Pay Per Sale, CPA)

The partner receives a fixed amount for a specific action, such as the first purchase of the given user. Money comes faster and it's easier to plan it: you know how much one conversion costs, and you can compare it to the price of a click on an ad network. But all the subsequent expenses of this user will not bring you anything.

This model is convenient for media buyers who buy traffic and want to quickly understand if the campaign pays off.

Revenue shareAction Payment
When the money arrivesgradually while the user spendsimmediately after the target action
predictabilitybelowabove
for whomSEO, content projects, channelsTraffic purchase, tests

{{cta}}

What affects income

  • Traffic quality

    The person who was looking for webcam chat and read your review is converted much better than a casual visitor with popup ads. Interest in the topic here weighs more volume.

  • GEO

    Audience's payability and available payment methods vary widely across countries. Similar traffic from different regions can give a very different result.

  • Conversion

    Share of visitors who registered and made a purchase. It is influenced by the format of the promo, location, site speed and how much the promise coincides with what a person sees after a click.

  • Device

    Mobile and desktop traffic behave differently. Check how your website and selected promotional materials look on your phone.

  • Hold

    If the user shares the revenue, it is important if the user returns. When the presentation is honest, the person is more willing to remain.

How to calculate the result

Apart from the numbers, one can only guess. Here is the minimum set of indicators that should be done from the first day.

  1. Visitors for each source: site, channel, advertising campaign.
  2. Clicks on affiliate links and widgets.
  3. registration and first purchases from statistics Stripcash.
  4. Accruals for the period and if you buy traffic, the cost of it.

Separate the sources using sub-accounts or labels, otherwise you won't understand which one brings money and which one just spends the budget. Learn more about tags and statistics in the section about Partner Tools.

To compare sources, the most convenient income per thousand visitors or one hundred clicks, it takes into account both the conversion and the quality of the audience. If you buy traffic, match this number with the price of the same thousand impressions or clicks. When expenses are consistently higher than the charges, it's time to change or stop the campaign. "Twisting" it in the hope of a miracle is usually useless.

Example of calculation logic

Let's say you have two sources: a review article on the site and a post in a thematic channel. On transitions, the channel wins, but in the statistics Stripcash it can be seen that there are more registrations and purchases from the article. It seems that review readers come with a more conscious interest. It is logical to write more detailed materials, and in the channel change the feed and try other formats. Figures in such a comparison are taken only from your statistics, there are no common “market averages” for this.

Evaluate the result over a long period, the first days say little. On a small amount of data, everything is decided by case: one purchase makes a week “successful”, and without it, the same week looks “failed”.

Realistic expectations

Affiliate income is not guaranteed. Many novice webmasters have been working at zero for months, while the site is gaining positions or until a working link in advertising is found. Paid purchase without numbers control easily goes down. It happens to many, and this is not a deception.

Third-party sites promising a specific income "from day one" usually make mistakes or exaggerate. Focus on the conditions in your office and your own statistics.

To avoid repeating other people's mistakes, read the analysis errors of beginners. When the first accruals appear, figure out how they are arranged Partner payments.

/partner/oshibki-novichkov/.body:
Why do beginners waste time

The mistakes of beginners in the affiliate Stripcash are surprisingly similar to each other. The program pays, the niche is alive, but the projects are still closed because of the same mistakes: someone is trying to cut off the path, someone does not count the numbers, someone expects something that does not happen. Below are eight such errors and what to do instead of them.

1. Thin and duplicated pages

Script is familiar. A person makes a website and generates a hundred pages for requests of the type “webs + city” or “webkam + category”, and the text is the same everywhere, only the keyword changes. After a couple of months, the search engines understand that the pages are no different, and the entire site goes under the filter, including normal pages.

It is better to make fewer pages, but each should have its own meaning. If there is nothing to fill the page with, except for replacing one word, it is not needed. One detailed guide brings more than twenty pacifiers. How to set up a small quality site, see about the site on GitHub Pages.

2. Spam instead of promotion

links in other people's chats, comments below each post, mass private messages. From the outside, it looks like a quick way to get transitions. In fact, accounts are blocked, complaints accumulate, and annoyed people buy almost nothing. In addition, spam violates the rules of the affiliate program, and you can lose accruals for it.

Build your own sites, whether it's a website, a channel or a community, and bring people there who came for the topic themselves.

3. Buying garbage traffic

Cheap clicks of "packs", dubious exchangers, offers like "ten thousand visitors for a penny." Such traffic consists entirely of bots or people who were paid for the transition. There will be no registrations or purchases from him, and the program may well consider it a fraud.

Buy traffic only from established advertising networks that officially accept 18+ topics, and start with a small budget. Read more in the article about Traffic Sources.

4. Ignore platform rules and law

Webcam advertising on general-purpose social networks, disguised links, and promotion where the audience may include minors. Beginners may think that “everyone does it” and nobody will notice. Violations are noticed, often after a channel or account has already built an audience.

Before launching, read the rules of the site, the conditions Stripcash and the requirements of the legislation of your country. If the topic is banned, look for another site. Workarounds don't work here.

{{cta}}

5. Work without analytics

One link to everything at once: site, channel, advertising. A month later, there are some registrations in the statistics, but it is not clear where they come from. What to develop, the beginner does not know and distributes forces blindly.

  • Enter a separate label for each source and each ad campaign.
  • Put the attendance counter on the site to see which pages are reading.
  • Once a week, make a table of visitors, clicks, registration and accrual.

How Tags and Statistics Work are described in Partner Tools.

6. Audience Deception

Clickbait headlines, promises of what is not on the service, fictional prices and “secret free private shows”. A person calls, sees something completely different and leaves. Trust in the site or channel drops, and with it the conversion of all future publications.

Write the truth, mention the cons and do not invent numbers. An honest review lives longer than the advertising text. If you are not sure about some fact, for example, in the price of tokens or payment methods, invite the reader to check it on the service itself. It's better than writing what will turn out to be wrong in a month. Outdated and fictional data undermine people's trust and spoil the attitude of search engines to the site.

7. Too early failure

A month after launching the SEO site, it almost always looks like a failure, because the search engines have just started indexing it. The first advertising campaign often goes into the red until the formats and GEO are selected. Many throw just at this moment, without waiting for data on which you can solve something.

Determine how much time and money you are willing to invest in the test, and summarize when this period ends. The first days don't talk about anything. Refusing a non-working source is normal, just the solution should rely on statistics, emotions are a bad adviser here.

8. Wrong expectations

Affiliate marketing is often sold as "passive income". In practice, this is work: you need to write texts, follow the rules, parse the numbers and try new approaches. income not guaranteed, and in some projects it remains zero. Anyone who is ready for this decides more calmly and rarely falls into the seven traps described above.

what the partner's income actually consists of is described in the article how to make money in Stripcash. Look at specific bets in the office, you should not believe advertising promises here.

short start-up checklist

  1. Read the rules Stripcash and the sites where you will work.
  2. Choose one traffic source that you already know how to handle.
  3. Make some useful unique pages or publications.
  4. Mark links with tags from day one.
  5. Evaluate the result after a pre-selected period.
{{cta}}

/partner/sajt-na-github/.body:
Why is the static site and GitHub Pages

the site on GitHub Pages is cheaper if you are just starting to work with your partner. Hosting is free, the server does not need to be administered, and the pages are loaded quickly, because these are ordinary HTML files. This site is arranged in the same way: the script collects texts, menus and meta tags into static pages, and live broadcasts are loaded through the iframe from the StripCash Promoting Tools.

The static site does not have a database, personal accounts and comments, he himself does not know anything. For an affiliate project, this is more of a plus. There is nothing to break and hack there, and all the attention goes to the useful text. You can read about other formats of promo in the article about partner tools.

Before launching, read the rules for valid use of GitHub. They limit frank content, so they place only text on such a site, and broadcasts are embedded in safe mode without frank previews. Don't forget about the laws of your country.

Step 1. Repository and publication

  1. Register an account on GitHub and create a public repository.
  2. Put the index.html file in the root. For each next page, start a separate folder with index.html inside, then the addresses will turn out to be neat, like /razdel/stranica/.
  3. Open Settings → Pages and select the source branch (usually Main) and root folder.
  4. After a minute or two, the site will open at the address of the user name.github.io/repository name.

When there are more than a dozen pages, prescribing the header and the menu in each hand is boring. It is more convenient to store texts separately and assemble the site with a small script or generator of static sites. The output will still get a set of HTML files.

Step 2. Own domain and CNAME

on the GitHub.io subdomain, the site is running, but it is better for a partner project to have its own domain. It is easier to remember, and it is not tied to the name of the account.

  1. Buy a domain from any registrar. It is better not to use other people's trademarks in the name if you do not understand the risks.
  2. In Settings → Pages, enter the domain in the Custom Domain field. GitHub will create a cname file with this domain in the repository, it cannot be deleted.
  3. Configure DNS at the registrar. Root domain A-records to GitHub Pages IP addresses from GitHub documentation, and for www, set a CNAME entry to the username.github.io.
  4. Wait for the DNS update. This usually takes from a few minutes to a day.

Step 3. HTTPS

As soon as the DNS works, GitHub will issue the certificate itself, and the Enforce HTTPS checkbox appears in Settings → Pages. Turn it on. Without HTTPS, browsers mark the site as insecure, and built-in broadcasts and forms may not load. The inactive check mark means that the DNS has not yet been updated or the entries are configured with an error.

Step 4: Built-in Broadcasts and Links

Generate the StripCash widget code with broadcasts in the StripCash cabinet. As a rule, this is an iframe tag, which already has your partner ID sewn up, and the category and display mode are set by parameters. Paste the code into the HTML pages in the place where the broadcasts should go.

  • Set iframe 100% width and suitable height, then check how it looks on the phone.
  • On the categories pages, turn on the corresponding broadcast filter so that the content matches the theme.
  • External referral links set the REL attribute with the Sponsored value. So you honestly inform the search engines that the link is affiliate.
{{cta}}

Step 5. Basic SEO

Title and Description

Each page needs its own title up to 60–65 characters with a key phrase at the beginning and its own description of 120–160 characters. The same title on different pages is taken as duplicates.

Unique text

The page where there is only iframe is empty for the search engine. Write texts that answer real questions: how to use the service, how the categories differ, how to maintain privacy. It is impossible to multiply one article by changing the keyword, so the site will quickly be under the filter. This trap is described in more detail in the analysis Newbie errors.

Sitemap and robots.txt

Create a sitemap.xml file with a list of all pages and update dates and specify the path to him in robots.txt. The generator or assembly script can do it automatically.

Search Console and Yandex Webmaster

Add the site to Google Search Console and Yandex Webmaster. The easiest way is to confirm the meta tag in the HEAD of the main page or a TXT record in the DNS. Then send sitemap and follow the indexing and error reports.

Step 6. Age labeling

A website about an adult service must clearly identify its subject. Add a rating meta tag with the value adult to the head section of every page; SafeSearch and parental filters use it. Place an 18+ warning in the footer or at the top of the page, and explain that the site is not an official Stripchat resource. This helps protect minors and reduces the risk of search engine penalties.

What's next

After launch, the work is just starting. In the first weeks, search engines look closely at the site, and there will be almost no traffic. Add useful pages regularly, fix bugs from webmaster reports and see statistics in the office Stripcash with labels breakdown. If you want to speed up, connect others Traffic sources and follow their rules.

/partner/vyplaty/.body:
How payments are arranged in Stripcash

Payouts Stripcash close the entire chain. The users you provided do what the program takes into account, accruals appear on the balance sheet, and when the amount reaches the threshold, it is transferred to you in the chosen way. It looks simple, but just here, beginners have the most questions: where is the money, why they didn’t come, what to write in the details.

I will make a reservation right away: this site is not an official resource Stripcash. There are no specific ways, minimum amounts, commissions and payment dates here, because they are set by the program, they differ in methods and change from time to time. You should only believe in the payment section in your personal account. If you haven't figured out where the charges come from yet, start with an article About payment models.

Money path: from click to your account

  1. The visitor clicks on your link or widget and registers on StripChat.
  2. He performs actions for which the program charges a reward, such as buying tokens.
  3. Accrual appears in the statistics. Some operations are checked for some time, affiliate programs are thus protected from fraud.
  4. The confirmed amount is accumulated on the partner's balance sheet.
  5. At the end of the billing period, if the balance is above the threshold and the details are filled out, a payment is formed.
  6. the money comes in the chosen way. How much they go depends on the method and payment system of the recipient.

Output methods and minimum threshold

Adult affiliate programs usually offer several kinds of payment methods: bank transfers, electronic payment services and other options available in particular countries. Your Stripcash dashboard lists the available methods and the minimum amount for each.

When choosing a method, compare several parameters.

  • Minimum amount. The threshold is different for different methods. As long as there is little traffic, the low threshold method will allow you to get the first money earlier.
  • Commission. In addition to the program commission, if any, consider the fees of your bank or wallet for incoming transfer and currency conversion.
  • Availability in your country. Not every method works in every jurisdiction, and some banks are wary of payments from adult entertainment companies.
  • Enrollment speed. Transfers between banks of different countries sometimes go longer than electronic payments.
{{cta}}

How often do payments come

In different affiliate programs, payments are different, somewhere in short cycles, about once a month. See the graph Stripcash in the program conditions. And keep a couple of moments in your head.

  • If the balance has not reached the threshold by the end of the period, the sum usually passes to the next period and continues to accumulate. The money doesn't go away, they just come later.
  • the payment is formed in one day, and at the expense it comes to another. Between these dates, the payment system processes it.

At the start, while there is little traffic, payments are irregular: in one period, the amount will exceed the threshold, in the other it is not. The charges are not lost from this. Look at the balance in the office, and if it grows, everything is in order. Plan your budget for advertising or domain renewal from already received payments. Accruals that are still on the test are not suitable for this.

why payment may be delayed

CauseWhat to do
Balance below the minimum thresholdWait for the next period or select a method with a different threshold
not filled in detailsSpecify the data in the profile in advance, not on the day of payment
error in the detailsCheck the recipient's name, account number or wallet letter to letter
Accrual on the checkWait for the check to finish, the conditions are described in the program rules
Suspicion of prohibited trafficContact support and honestly describe the sources

Pay special attention to the last line. If the program finds cheating, bots or motivated traffic, accruals can be canceled. There is only one way to reliably protect: work with honest sources described in the article about Traffic sources.

Taxes and Accounting

Partnership Remuneration is considered income, and in most countries it is paid tax. The order depends on the jurisdiction and your status: an individual, self-employed, individual entrepreneur or company. There is no single recipe, there are only general tips.

  • Save the payment history and account statements, they will be needed for reporting.
  • Record project costs: domain, hosting, advertising. In some modes, they can be deducted.
  • If money comes from abroad, deal with currency control.
  • When the amounts become noticeable, go to an accountant or tax consultant in your country.
This section is not a tax or legal advice. The rules change, and the recipient himself is responsible for the declaration of income.

Short checklist before the first payment

  1. Fill in the profile and details immediately after registration.
  2. Read the threshold, schedule and commission for the selected method in the office.
  3. Check if your bank or wallet accepts such transfers.
  4. Compare the expected payout amount at the end of the period.

If you have not yet decided where to start working in the program, return to affiliate review.

{{cta}}

/partner/white-label/.body:
What is White Label

White Label Webcam website is a project called your name, logo and domain based on the StripChat platform. The visitor sees your brand, watches broadcasts, registers and buys tokens without leaving your address. Heavy infrastructure (video servers, payment system, moderation, support) remains with the service.

The term came from trade, where the so-called "white label" is called, on which the seller glues his own name. Among partner tools in adult programs is one of the most advanced, and it is not suitable for everyone.

how White Label differs from referral link

referral linkWhite label
where there is a visitoron the Stripchat websiteon your domain
whose brand is seen by the userStripchatyour
entry thresholdMinimum: Copy linkAbove: Domain, Setup, Design
What are you promotingAlien serviceOwn project
Recognitionworks for someone else's brandaccumulates from you

How it looks for the user

A person finds your site in the search or link from the channel and sees your logo, broadcast catalog and registration button. He starts an account, replenishes the balance and communicates in the chat, although technically all this is serviced by the platform. For him, your site looks like an independent service, so the design, texts and rules should be neat and inspire confidence.

what it looks like for a partner

You have a brand, domain, page content and promotion. The activity of users from your site falls into the statistics of the program, and accruals come on conditions from the office. Technical updates, video streams and payment processing do without your participation, but you cannot influence them either.

If the link simply transfers traffic further, White Label allows you to build your brand. Users return directly to it: dial your address or open it from bookmarks. The difference here is more in strategy than in technology.

Pros White Label

  • Own brand

    The name and domain belong to you, and regular users remember your site.

  • without their infrastructure

    raise video servers, connect payment systems and maintain user support.

  • Feed control

    You can focus on a particular niche, language, or audience without showing the entire catalog at once.

  • Convenience for SEO

    All content and link mass are collected on the same domain and do not spread across other people's pages.

Cons and pitfalls

  • Traffic is still needed. Branded site without visitors brings nothing. The problem of attracting the audience to White Label does not solve, it changes only the place where it comes.
  • responsibility becomes more. The domain and its extension, DNS, compliance with the laws and regulations of the program fall on you.
  • You depend on the platform. Technically, the site works on the service, so any changes in its conditions or functions apply to you.
  • The new brand is not immediately trusted. An unfamiliar name tells the visitor less than a known service, and trust will have to earn with content and honest presentation.
  • Advertising restrictions do not go anywhere. Own adult brand, like any other traffic, can only be promoted where the subject is allowed.
The specific White Label conditions, including the partner requirements and the accrual order, are specified in the Cabinet Stripcash. Read them in full before launching.
{{cta}}

Who is White Label suitable for?

It is worth taking on this format if you already have a stable audience source or a clear plan where to get it. Most often, these are the cases:

  • An adult website owner who wants users to stay within their ecosystem.
  • SEO professional with promoting experience, ready to build one strong domain instead of a lot of small pages.
  • A team that works with a narrow niche or language audience and wants to issue a proposal for it.
  • Media Bayer, which is important to drive traffic to your own brand and save a base of returning visitors.

It is better for a beginner without traffic to start with referral links and built-in broadcasts on a simple site. It's cheaper and faster, it becomes clearer if you manage to bring your audience. How to launch such a site for free, according to the guide About the site on GitHub Pages.

What to prepare before launching

  1. Determine the niche and audience: for whom the site and how it differs from hundreds of similar ones.
  2. Select a domain: short, easy to remember, without other people's trademarks in the title.
  3. Learn the White Label conditions in the office and design requirements.
  4. Prepare content: descriptions, rules, 18+ warning page and privacy information.
  5. Consider traffic sources before launch, then it will be too late. options are analyzed in the article about Traffic sources.
  6. Configure analytics and labels to understand where users come from from day one.

Separately, think about how your site will be useful in addition to the catalog itself. For example, detailed guides for beginners, niche selections, or answers to frequent questions in your language. Such content drives search traffic and explains to the user why to return to you when you can dial the address of a large service directly.

Expectations are better to keep sober. The new brand gathers the audience for months, and the income at this time may be zero or very small. If the project takes root, you will have your own website, and not just a set of links to someone else's.
